tagline: High-end Tulum by sea — a luxury charter market and a coastal bypass of the congested Highway 307.
summary: Tulum anchors the boutique-luxury end of the Riviera Maya, but its beach has no formal harbour. The practical sea gateway is Puerto Aventuras, the closest working marina between Tulum and Playa del Carmen and the base for a busy luxury yacht and charter market running across to Cozumel's El Cielo sandbar. For Navier Experiences, this is a premium hospitality-transfer and island-hopping node; a coastal run also bypasses the notoriously congested Highway 307.

navier_fit.pioneer_ii: Pioneer II covers the Puerto Aventuras↔Cozumel (~12 nm) and ↔Playa (~8 nm) runs comfortably.
navier_fit.quanta_lr: Quanta-LR (H2 2026+) is optional here; the core network is well inside Pioneer II all-electric range.

competitive_landscape: A fragmented luxury-charter market operates today with no scheduled premium tier; the pain is price, fragmentation and Highway 307 congestion on the land alternative.
seasonality: Atlantic hurricane season (Jun–Nov); sargassum (Apr–Aug) a coastal nuisance. The nearshore corridor is relatively protected.
regulatory_note: Mexican jurisdiction: API Quintana Roo, Capitanía de Puerto (SEMAR). Clean-fleet operation aligns with the Mesoamerican Reef's protected status off Cozumel.
